title: Pulse Mirror
concept: The dot moves forward while a periodic pulse expands outward; each tap reflects the pulse back, creating a mirrored wave that can pass through opposite‑side barriers, letting you toggle which side of the tunnel is cleared.

title: Orbit Pulse
concept: A dot orbits a moving nucleus; tapping releases a radial pulse that expands the orbit radius for a brief window, letting the dot slip through outer obstacles before it contracts back.

title: Momentum Flip
concept: The dot constantly accelerates forward; each tap instantly reverses its velocity vector, letting you dodge incoming wall spikes that only appear in the current direction of travel.
